posts.name: Hemory
posts.tagline: Keep listening. Searchable memory for your AI agents.
posts.description: Hemory comes from Hear + Memory. It's not meeting transcription: Hemory listens on the phone or Apple Watch you already own, and keeps every conversation as memory. Your day is auto-split into moments with speaker labels, then settles into a private, searchable memory. Connect it to Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any agent over MCP, and your AI finally has real context to revisit what you heard and build on it.

posts.name: Eclatira
posts.tagline: Conversational Video Agent That Plugs Into Any Stack
posts.description: Plug real-time conversational video AI into any application. Eclatira gives developers native voice-to-voice, live vision, and full-stack execution across custom APIs, MCPs, and 3,000+ apps. Ship autonomous multimodal video agents fast.

posts.name: Chit
posts.tagline: A printed receipt of your day in Claude Code
posts.description: Chit reads the Claude Code transcripts already on your disk and prints the day back as a receipt, grouped by project and ready to paste into a standup. A 777 KB Mac app. No Hammerspoon, no Python, no account, and no network code in the binary at all.

posts.name: MakerMap
posts.tagline: A living map of makers and what they’re building
posts.description: MakerMap is a living map of the maker world. Discover 4,000+ makers and products, search by niche, location, interests or what people are building, explore live profiles, and find people worth meeting. Add yourself and become part of the map.

posts.name: Paragraph Notes
posts.tagline: A private Markdown notes app for Mac
posts.description: Paragraph Notes is a privacy-focused Markdown notes app for Mac. Write in a simple, distraction-free plain text editor. Paragraph Notes collects no data and never connects to the internet. Notes are stored locally in an open, portable format. Use Paragraph Notes free for up to 20 notes. Upgrade to Pro with a one-time in-app purchase for unlimited notes.

posts.name: GoodSocials
posts.tagline: AI social media manager for LinkedIn. Only authentic content
posts.description: AI social media manager for LinkedIn. Writes high quality content, you approve it in a kanban board, it schedules so you post regularly, close to daily.

posts.name: Fewer
posts.tagline: The launcher that counts how often you pick up your phone
posts.description: An Android launcher built around pickups, not screen time. A quiet home screen shows today's task, how many times you've looked at your phone (and how many for nothing) and the six tools you actually use. Time sinks get a pause. No server, no account, no ads.

posts.name: Kleanly
posts.tagline: One tap in the notch locks your keyboard and trackpad
posts.description: Kleanly lives in your MacBook's notch. Tap it once and your keyboard and trackpad are locked, so you can wipe everything down while your video keeps playing. Kids can slap the keys during a cartoon and nothing gets typed. Double tap the trackpad when you're done. New since our first launch: the notch control, in-app updates, moving your license to a new Mac yourself, and a small tab on displays without a notch.

posts.name: Psst
posts.tagline: A shared shopping list that remembers what things cost
posts.description: Psst is a shared shopping list. The useful part is that it remembers what you paid. Photograph a receipt and the lines come back structured, each one showing a crop of the row it came from and what that item cost last time, and where. Most of the work went into not saying so when it isn't sure. Two prices in different units are never compared, and comparison is on unit price, not the line total: buying 2kg instead of 1kg is not a price rise. iOS and Android.

posts.name: Lisen
posts.tagline: Free Read Aloud with Cartesia Voices
posts.description: Free read aloud for any article with your Cartesia voices. No subscription on top of your Cartesia plan.

posts.name: SOUND
posts.tagline: Give every Mac app its own EQ, volume, and speaker.
posts.description: macOS has one volume slider and no equalizer. SOUND gives every playing app its own 8-band EQ, independent volume, and output device—right from the menu bar. No virtual audio driver or account; audio stays on your Mac. Free and available in 10 languages.

posts.name: VehicleERP
posts.tagline: VehicleERP - Used Car Management Software
posts.description: VehicleERP is used car management software built for dealers who buy, sell, and manage vehicles. Track inventory, purchases, expenses, sales, payments, GST bills, partners, staff, branches, and profit on one platform. AI helps price vehicles, scan documents, spot ageing stock and mistakes, forecast performance, and answer questions using your business data.

posts.name: What to Order
posts.tagline: Find food you’ll love on any restaurant menu
posts.description: Ever sat down at The Cheesecake Factory and been handed the menu? 331 items. You flip through it, get nowhere, and order the same thing as last time. What to Order works the other way around. Tell it what you’re in the mood for and it checks every dish on the menu for you. “Spicy” works. “Spicy vegetarian” too. Ask for “Thanksgiving dinner for 2” and you get a whole order, pumpkin cheesecake included. We have 7 US chains so far. Eating somewhere else? Snap a photo of the menu. It’s free.

posts.name: ZenMode OS · Android Launcher
posts.tagline: Good phone habits! paid in gold, all with your friends.
posts.description: ZenMode OS is an open source Android launcher that makes the intentional choice easier than the impulsive one. One Zen Score, real accountability, and rewards that land in gold instead of dopamine.

posts.name: Big Weather
posts.tagline: Menu Bar Forecast, now with AI Insights
posts.description: Big Weather puts the weather in your Mac's menu bar: the days ahead as one curve you can scrub through, UV hour by hour, and with Premium, AI insights and official weather warnings.

posts.name: Farao
posts.tagline: Trade with friends, post thesis, earn money
posts.description: Follow your friends and other traders whose records are visible, read the thesis behind every position, and mirror the trade at your own size.

posts.name: ButterShare
posts.tagline: Share Anything, to Anyone. No File Limits
posts.description: ButterShare allows you to share files of any size directly between devices without the need for cloud storage or sign-ups. With a simple 3-step process, you can send files instantly using a 6-character room code. The service ensures privacy with end-to-end encryption, making it ideal for sharing large files securely.

posts.name: Bump
posts.tagline: Your AI collections team for email and WhatsApp
posts.description: Bump is an AI collections engine for accounts receivable. It works every overdue invoice to paid — chasing across email and WhatsApp, reading replies, tracking promises and payment plans, and escalating on its own — so getting paid runs itself. Like adding a collections team, without hiring one.

posts.name: Onto
posts.tagline: Your website, readable to AI agents
posts.description: AI agents read your site as raw HTML, and you can’t see them. Onto serves them clean Markdown at the same URL, while people and Google get your page as before, and shows you which agents came. Plus an AIO score, and a Read API and MCP for builders.

posts.name: Finantly
posts.tagline: All your finances in one place — budgets and investments.
posts.description: Finantly brings your accounts, budgets, investments and debts into one clear view. Import bank CSV files with auto-categories that learn your choices, track net worth in real time across currencies, and plan with FIRE, car, real estate and loan calculators built on your data — not guesswork. Full control over your money, no spreadsheets required.

posts.name: Asụsụ Ọma
posts.tagline: Learn Igbo with guided lessons, real Igbo voices and games
posts.description: Igbo has tens of millions of speakers and almost nowhere to learn it properly. Asụsụ Ọma is a free Igbo learning app: guided lessons, games, folktales, and every phrase recorded by a native speaker. No ads, no subscription, nothing behind a payment.

posts.name: nerfWatch()
posts.tagline: Daily AI benchmarks and community votes on model quality
posts.description: nerfWatch() tests AI models daily through their APIs, against each model's first week of tracking. See scores beside community votes, get alerts for declines and recoveries, and inspect the open-source engine. API tests, not chat-app tests.

posts.name: Katteb Goals
posts.tagline: Give an AI agent a goal and a deadline, get a daily report
posts.description: A goal is an outcome with a deadline. Tell a Katteb agent what you want, like 20 new qualified leads every working day or 15 discovery calls in 30 days, and it plans the work, runs it on a schedule for weeks, remembers what it did and sends you a report every day. Start from 100 ready goals across leads, sales and marketing, or write your own. The Goals plan runs five agents at once. Goals are not guaranteed, and you can change or stop a goal at any time.

posts.name: Flag Quiz
posts.tagline: Learn the flags of the world
posts.description: Ireland or Ivory Coast? Slovakia or Slovenia? Flag Quiz helps you learn them all, one at a time. The ones you miss come back until they stick, and mnemonics make the tricky ones unforgettable. Learn every flag, and you'll hold the whole world in your mind.

posts.name: Puzzly
posts.tagline: Turn any pic into a multiplayer jigsaw puzzle. No sign-ups
posts.description: Puzzly turns any photo into a real-time collaborative jigsaw puzzle for 1 to 6 players. Upload an image, create a room, share one link, and start solving together instantly. See live cursors, grabs, reactions and merges as they happen. No signup, no accounts, no ads. Solo mode and challenge links are included too.

posts.name: Prompt Workbench
posts.tagline: Open-source Prompt Management solution
posts.description: Prompt Workbench is a local, open-source developer application for creating, versioning, testing, comparing and publishing LLM prompts and linear prompt chains. Develop and compare prompts locally, then ship the exact versions you tested as ordinary, portable files that any language can load — with no cloud account and no vendor lock-in.

posts.name: MemoryLane
posts.tagline: Rediscover the memories sitting on your drives.
posts.description: MemoryLane indexes the photo and video folders you already have and turns them into a fast, rediscoverable library on your own machine. Built for people with large archives and for photographers.

posts.name: CozyToolkit

posts.description: Free online tools for images, PDFs, writing and video. Everyday tools are free; hosted features have free allowances.cozy place. Sign in for unlimited everyday tools.

Ideal for content creators, travel enthusiasts, and marketers who want to visualize journeys with professional-quality animations.

Connect the tools you already use, let your Twin understand your patterns, and turn the internet from something designed to control your attention into something that actually works for you.

posts.description: Realwater is a hydration tracker that turns your daily goal into a living sphere of water. Log drinks in one tap, watch the level rise, and get reminders that fit your routine. Set a goal based on your body, activity and climate, track streaks and trends, and customize the experience. It works offline with no account, and Premium is a one-time purchase, no subscription.

No root needed, with optional Shizuku for deeper control. Free to use, with a one-time Pro unlock. No subscription.

The project started as an experiment to see how far I could take a personal idea using AI across design, assets and development. No ads, no IAP, and fully playable offline.

posts.name: NumBan
posts.tagline: Report voicemail callback numbers, not spoofed caller ID.
posts.description: NumBan is the first app to combat phone scammers using the number they leave on your voicemail, which cannot be faked. Most apps block the caller's phone number, which is a spoofed caller ID. Users can simply share the voicemail with NumBan and our system will transcribe it, extract the number, look up the phone carrier, and report the number to their abuse team. When we detect that a number has been abandoned, we count it as a kill and increment our leaderboard!

Map physical cable connections, store credentials safely, and view everything in a clean, searchable Bootstrap 5 dashboard. No cloud dependencies, no heavy JS frameworks—just pure Python, SQLite, and full privacy.

Skip the month it takes to schedule five.

posts.tagline: Investigate sources from highlighted text in your browser
posts.description: according to is a Chromium browser extension that checks claims on any page and reports attribution, not hallucinated verdicts — real sources, weighed by a sources-list you curate. YOU decide the trustworthiness of the sources - the AI measures claims against your sources. I want to give consumers of information agency while using AI sustainably. I tested this rigorously, but still be aware: AI can make mistakes.

posts.name: Nufa
posts.tagline: Read real books in your target language, tap any word
posts.description: Nufa is an e-reader built for language learners. Import your own EPUB or PDF books, tap any word for an instant translation, and save it to built-in spaced repetition with the sentence you found it in. Stuck on a passage? Get a breakdown of the grammar and phrasing without leaving the page. No more juggling an ebook, a dictionary and a flashcard app. Free to use, with optional premium extras. Available now on Android.

posts.name: cueloop
posts.tagline: A terminal-first multiplayer thread for agent-authored work.
posts.description: cueloop opens your agent's plan or diff in the terminal, where you comment on exact lines and send back a Message it can act on.

posts.name: ClipboardX
posts.tagline: Seamless clipboard sync between Android and Windows
posts.description: ClipboardX syncs text and images between Android and Windows, so you can copy on one device and use it on the other without sending things to yourself through a messenger. It includes clipboard history, an Android keyboard with direct clipboard access, QR device pairing and privacy controls. No account is required. I originally built it to solve my own frustration with moving logs, links and screenshots between my phone and PC.

posts.name: SportsOS
posts.tagline: "Play More. Manage Less. The Operating System for Sports."
posts.description: nlike basic booking apps, SportsOS unifies players, facilities, and enterprises into one operating system: • Instant court booking with 4-way UPI group bill splitting • Verified athlete Sports IDs & Elo matchmaking • AI Video Lab for slow-mo swing analysis & reels • IoT smart turnstiles for unstaffed venue access • Corporate leagues with health insurance rebate audits From a player's first serve to automated physical venue access, SportsOS removes all friction from sports.

posts.name: OnePayCV
posts.tagline: Resume builder without sneaky monthly fees
posts.description: We’ve all been there: you spend an hour building the perfect resume, only to face a hidden $40/mo subscription paywall. OnePayCV changes that! Get beautifully designed, human-first & 100% ATS-proof templates with a single payment. Pay once, edit and download your perfect CV forever. No traps.

posts.name: Burrow
posts.tagline: Voice AI researcher on infinite canvas. Local-first, BYOK.
posts.description: Burrow is a local-first, voice-driven AI research workspace built around an infinite canvas. Instead of keeping research buried in chat, it lets you explore topics, read documents, search the web and papers, create notes, connect ideas, and organize everything visually. It supports BYOK AI providers, local models, voice input, and persistent workspaces—giving you control over your data, models, and research process.

posts.name: UPI Fee Calculator
posts.tagline: Calculate UPI merchant charges under India's new MDR rules
posts.description: India's UPI merchant discount rate changes on 15 October 2026, and most coverage of it described a merchant-side charge as a fee on ordinary users. Enter an amount, pick the payment type, and get the MDR with the arithmetic shown and the source named. Every rate, threshold and cap comes from the official Ministry of Finance FAQ and press release. Where those documents are silent, it says so rather than guessing. English and Hindi. Runs in your browser; nothing you type is sent anywhere.

posts.name: Kit Loop app
posts.tagline: Pack - Check - Bring it back
posts.description: KitLoop helps you pack what you need - and make sure it all comes back. Build reusable kits, label items with QR codes, and check everything in and out for trips, events, and everyday gear. From camera kits and tools to sports equipment, keep a clear list of what went out and what returned. Simple for one person, solid for a team. Pack it. Take it. Bring it all back.

posts.name: Notig -just notes until include a secret
posts.tagline: Private notes & photos behind a secret phrase, "open sesame"
posts.description: Notig is an iPhone notebook with a private space behind your own phrase. Type it into any normal note to reveal secret Notes, Media and Settings; the phrase disappears from the public draft. Write with rich text, keep one secret note free, then unlock more notes and private photo/video imports with a one-time Lifetime purchase. Your content stays on your device—no account, cloud vault or recovery. When you leave the app, it returns to normal notes.

posts.name: hintl
posts.tagline: Evidence scores for supplements & habits, not just reviews
posts.description: hintl turns public research (PubMed, etc.) into plain-language evidence scores for supplements and habits -- sleep, focus, stress, nutrition, beauty, work. Every ingredient gets a 0-100 score instead of "works/doesn't work," shown honestly even when weak, always linked to source studies. New: a shop-by-evidence product catalog (browse by research score, not marketing copy), plus a free embeddable score badge + citation sentence for your own blog or page -- the score travels with the claim.

posts.name: AdCreator AI
posts.tagline: Turn Shopify product photos into finished ads in 60 seconds
posts.description: AdCreator AI is a Shopify app that turns product photos into finished ads for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Google in about 60 seconds, without design skills. Pick a product, get the ad image and channel-specific copy. Free plan: 6 image ads a month.

posts.name: CoinPriceAlert
posts.tagline: Crypto price alerts that actually reach you — push, Telegram
posts.description: Coin Price Alert watches the coins you choose and tells you the moment your line is crossed — a price, a percentage move, an RSI level, a volume spike or a MACD crossover. Alerts arrive by push, Telegram or email. No exchange key, no wallet connection. Ten alerts are free

posts.name: Principles Before Personalities
posts.tagline: A free, offline reader for the 1939 Big Book
posts.description: A reader for the public-domain first edition of the Big Book (1939 text with 1941 revisions), with meeting page numbers. Highlight, mark pages, add sticky notes, search. No account, nothing uploaded. Free for Mac, Windows, Android, iPhone (web app). Not affiliated with AA World Services.

posts.name: Parivar AI
posts.tagline: AI companions that remember you and grow with you
posts.description: Parivar AI is building a new kind of AI companion — one that doesn't just answer questions, but understands the person behind them. Unlike traditional chatbots, Parivar AI focuses on memory, personality, and meaningful conversations. It learns your preferences, remembers important moments, and becomes more personalized over time. By understanding your goals, habits, and challenges, AI can become more than a tool — it can support personal growth and self-reflection.

posts.name: MilkMade
posts.tagline: Baby Feeding & Pump Tracker
posts.description: MilkMade is a free feeding tracker (ad supported) for every baby. Whether you are mother who breastfeeds or pumps, or parents who are bottle-feeding with formula or from a milk bank, MilkMade is there for you. The app was built by my wife (A Registered Midwife) and I, developing a solution that is simple, clear and easy to use during a 3am feed. We have a Pro Subscription that provides the support when you need it most, giving you context behind the numbers that you are tracking.

posts.name: PitchMirror
posts.tagline: Turn Your Startup Website Into an Investor-Readiness Report
posts.description: PitchMirror analyzes a startup’s public website across relevant pages and turns it into a structured investor-readiness report. It highlights strengths, gaps, cross-page findings, investor questions, and actionable next steps—helping founders see their website from an investor-focused perspective.

posts.name: Kotowaza Karuta
posts.tagline: Learn 2,000 Japanese proverbs with karuta cards and quizzes
posts.description: Kotowaza Karuta helps you learn Japanese proverbs, idioms, four-character phrases and classical sayings through illustrated karuta cards and quizzes. 2,000 entries with furigana on every kanji; start with 400 free, with no account and no ads. Three quiz formats, eight goal-based courses (including one for Japanese learners), mastery tracking and weak-word review. Premium is a one-time purchase that unlocks all 2,000 entries. Web and Android, in Japanese and English.

posts.name: The $5K Offer Machine
posts.tagline: Close $5K clients without calls. No Zoom, No Calendly
posts.description: I am Akshay Tanaji Deokar from India. I hate sales calls. I built this 18-page system to close $4,999 clients from my phone using just 3 DMs + 1 Link. No Calendly, No Zoom. Includes DM scripts, $5K sales page template & async tracker. No calls needed. For founders doing $10K/mo who want $50K/mo. Not for beginners. Maker: Akshay Tanaji Deokar

posts.name: The Working Joe
posts.tagline: Find out if your business idea is worth pursuing
posts.description: A practical business-idea check for trades, services, skills, and side businesses. See what lines up, what doesn't, and what to check before you put real money into it. Free first read, no card required.

posts.name: My Angel app
posts.tagline: My Angel Keeps you instantly connected with your loved ones
posts.description: My Angel Keeps you instantly connected with your loved ones through effortless, safe check-ins! All of this is powered by our cutting-edge AI. Plus, with the optional GPS tracking, you'll always know exactly where they are! 🌟 And your Angels do not need the app to get updates, locations or alerts! My Angel creates instant reminders for users to connect with their Angels, to let them know they are safe and well. Each day the app plays the role of intelligent proactive safety with custom schedules

posts.name: Tracklift Gym Companion
posts.tagline: Lifting programs that adapt after every single workout
posts.description: Tracklift builds a gym program around your goal, experience, equipment, and schedule. Then it adapts as you train. Our Smart Adapt technology reviews your logged performance and proposes the exact adjustments for next time; Smart Adapt will tell you when you're ready for progressive overload or it can even detect fatigue and schedule a deload. We make suggestions and help you stay on track but the final decisions are always yours.
